The Eras Tour.text: After the first US leg, Taylor Swift gave $100,000 bonuses to each of the 50 truck drivers hauling the stage.
The Eras Tour.evidence: At the conclusion of the first US leg, Swift gave "unprecedented" bonus payments totaling over $55 million to her entire touring crew, including $100,000 to each of the 50 truck drivers involved in transporting the stage setup and production equipment.

Music of the Spheres World Tour.text: Coldplay planted a tree for every ticket sold and cut the tour's emissions by 59% compared with their previous one.
Music of the Spheres World Tour.evidence: Other ideas included crafting the first rechargeable mobile show battery in the world with BMW and planting a tree for every ticket sold. Emissions fell by 59% in comparison to the group's previous tour

After Hours til Dawn Tour.text: Its stage was a row of ruined buildings modelled on the Weeknd's hometown, Toronto.
After Hours til Dawn Tour.evidence: The stage design had three stages: the main stage, showcasing a row of destroyed buildings modeled after the Weeknd's hometown of Toronto, and a screen behind them showing visuals of a futuristic post-apocalyptic skyline

Farewell Yellow Brick Road.text: Its Dodger Stadium show, streamed on Disney+, won the Emmy that completed Elton John's EGOT.
Farewell Yellow Brick Road.evidence: Before that, the Dodger Stadium concert on 20 November 2022 was livestreamed on Disney+ as Elton John Live: Farewell from Dodger Stadium. ... The recording would go on to win the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Variety Special (Live) at the 75th ceremony in 2024, allowing John to attain EGOT status.

Mathematics Tour.text: Its logo first appeared on Ipswich Town shirts, sponsored by Ed Sheeran, four months before the tour was announced.
Mathematics Tour.evidence: The "+−=÷× Tour" logo was first revealed on 6 May 2021 when Sheeran was announced as the shirt sponsor of Ipswich Town F.C. for their upcoming season in 2021–22 EFL League One, four months before the tour itself was announced.

Divide Tour.text: Ed Sheeran sold more than 300,000 tickets for seven shows in Ireland in a single day, a first there.
Divide Tour.evidence: In Ireland, more than 300,000 tickets for seven shows across Cork, Belfast, Galway and Dublin were sold in a single day, making history with Sheeran being the only artist to ever do so in Irish territory.

360° Tour.text: U2's 2009 Rose Bowl show was the first concert streamed live on YouTube, watched by nearly 10 million.
360° Tour.evidence: The 25 October 2009 concert from the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California ... was simultaneously broadcast live on YouTube ... It was the first time a concert was streamed live on YouTube, and nearly 10 million people from 188 countries were reported to have watched.

Springsteen and E Street Band 2023–2025.text: COVID kept Nils Lofgren out of a Houston show, the first he had missed since joining the E Street Band in 1984.
Springsteen and E Street Band 2023–2025.evidence: On February 13, 2023, it was announced that guitarist Nils Lofgren had tested positive, and he was absent from the February 14th show in Houston. It was the first show Lofgren had missed since joining the E Street Band in 1984.

M72 World Tour.text: At Virginia Tech, Metallica fans jumping to "Enter Sandman" registered as a small earthquake.
M72 World Tour.evidence: The band's performance of "Enter Sandman," combined with the large crowd jumping and cheering, generated enough ground movement and tremors to be registered as a small earthquake by the Virginia Tech Seismological Observatory.

Love On Tour.text: At his "Harryween" shows in New York, Harry Styles dressed as Dorothy Gale and the whole crowd came in costume.
Love On Tour.evidence: In October 2021, during the tour, Styles held a two-day Halloween event at New York City's Madison Square Garden arena, called "Harryween Fancy Dress Party", where all concertgoers dressed in costumes, with Styles himself dressed as Dorothy Gale and a Pierrot clown.
